$Comment: The everyday token storefront. Currencies is the balance strip in the header: list every wallet this shop prices in, so a player can see what they can afford before they browse. CategoryOrder fixes the order the shelves appear in; leave it out and they sort alphabetically, which puts 'rare' ahead of 'uncommon'. A category not named here follows the listed ones alphabetically, and each offer's own SortOrder still arranges offers WITHIN one shelf.
